These exercises use the shared `JXG.QuartoGraphEditor` API. Click **Show
controls** on any canvas for a reminder of the interactions. Every graph is
converted from the editor's JSON response into a validated NetworkX graph by
the shared `graph_from_response(...)` checker helper. See the
[graph-editor API reference](docs/graph-editor.html) for authoring details.

## Construct a tree

Construct a tree with at least five vertices.

```{.jsxgraph assessment_id="tree-construction-board" width="800" height="520" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; max-width:100%;"}
var editor = JXG.QuartoGraphEditor.createBoard();
editor.register({
  ai: {
    render: true,
    summary: function (data) {
      return {
        representation: data.representation,
        vertexCount: data.nodes.length,
        edgeCount: data.edges.length,
        feedbackPolicy: 'Discuss connectedness and cycles without proposing a finished graph.'
      };
    }
  }
});
```

```{math-exercise}
#|       import networkx as nx

#|           return {"score": 0, "feedback": "Use at least five vertices."}

#|       return {"score": 1, "feedback": "This graph is a tree."}

Construct a tree with at least five vertices.
```

## Give a graph with an Euler circuit

Construct a graph with at least four vertices and four edges that has an Euler
circuit: a closed trail that uses every edge exactly once.

```{.jsxgraph assessment_id="euler-construction-board" width="800" height="520" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; max-width:100%;"}
var editor = JXG.QuartoGraphEditor.createBoard();
editor.register({
  ai: {
    render: true,
    summary: function (data) {
      return {
        representation: data.representation,
        vertexCount: data.nodes.length,
        edgeCount: data.edges.length,
        feedbackPolicy: 'Discuss connectedness and vertex degrees without proposing a finished graph.'
      };
    }
  }
});
```

```{math-exercise}

#| packages: networkx

#| checker: |
#|   def check(response, symbols):
#|       import networkx as nx
#|       try:
#|           graph = graph_from_response(response)
#|       except ValueError:
#|           return {"score": 0, "feedback": "The board returned a malformed graph."}
#|       if graph.number_of_nodes() < 4:
#|           return {"score": 0, "feedback": "Use at least four vertices."}
#|       if graph.number_of_edges() < 4:
#|           return {"score": 0, "feedback": "Use at least four edges."}
#|       if not nx.is_connected(graph):
#|           return {"score": 0, "feedback": "Join all vertices into one connected graph."}
#|       if not nx.is_eulerian(graph):
#|           return {"score": 0, "feedback": "An Euler circuit requires every vertex to have even degree."}
#|       return {"score": 1, "feedback": "This graph has an Euler circuit."}

Construct a graph with at least four vertices and four edges that has an Euler
circuit.
```

## Make a non-planar graph

Construct a non-planar graph: one that cannot be drawn in the plane without
crossing edges. Moving vertices can change the picture, but not whether the
underlying graph is planar.

```{.jsxgraph assessment_id="nonplanar-construction-board" width="800" height="520" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; max-width:100%;"}
var editor = JXG.QuartoGraphEditor.createBoard();
editor.register({
  ai: {
    render: true,
    summary: function (data) {
      return {
        representation: data.representation,
        vertexCount: data.nodes.length,
        edgeCount: data.edges.length,
        feedbackPolicy: 'Discuss graph structure and planarity without proposing a finished graph.'
      };
    }
  }
});
```

```{math-exercise}

#|       if graph.number_of_nodes() < 5:
#|           return {"score": 0, "feedback": "A simple non-planar graph needs at least five vertices."}
#|       if graph.number_of_edges() < 9:

Construct a non-planar graph.
```

## Give an example of a bipartite graph

Construct a connected bipartite graph with at least four vertices and at least
four edges.

```{.jsxgraph assessment_id="bipartite-graph-board" width="800" height="520" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px; max-width:100%;"}
var editor = JXG.QuartoGraphEditor.createBoard();
editor.register({
  ai: {
    render: true,
    summary: function (data) {
      return {
        representation: data.representation,
        vertexCount: data.nodes.length,
        edgeCount: data.edges.length,
        feedbackPolicy: 'Discuss bipartitions and odd cycles without proposing a finished graph.'
      };
    }
  }
});
```

```{math-exercise}
#|       if graph.number_of_nodes() < 4:
#|           return {"score": 0, "feedback": "Use at least four vertices."}
#|       if graph.number_of_edges() < 4:
#|           return {"score": 0, "feedback": "Add at least four edges."}
#|       if not nx.is_connected(graph):
#|           return {"score": 0, "feedback": "Make the graph connected."}

Construct a connected bipartite graph with at least four vertices and at least
four edges.
```
